newsitem.title: CHINA: China holds live-ammo war games in northeast.
newsitem.headline: China holds live-ammo war games in northeast.

text.p: China has staged live ammunition war games in its northeastern Shenyang military zone, the Liberation Army Daily said on Wednesday.
The exercises used live ammunition and were held under high-technology conditions on the Horqin grasslands, it said.
The Horqin area is in the northern region of Inner Mongolia near its border with Jilin province.
The newspaper did not identify the military units that took part in the exercises and did not say when the drills were held.
Two photographs accompanying the terse report showed a row of tanks shrouded in smoke and a line of armoured vehicles crossing a river.
China said on Sunday it had staged amphibious war games that had helped its military hone its ability to land forces on distant shores.
In March, China held missile tests and war games near Taiwan, which Beijing regards as a rebel province, in a bid to intimidate the island ahead of presidential elections.
Chinese Defence Minister Chi Haotian told U.S. military officials on Tuesday that China refused to renounce the use of force to reclaim Taiwan.
